endpoints.note: autosociaal / Dealertemplates (Laravel+Livewire SaaS, nginx; frontend from cdn.autosociaal.nl/dtweb/, vehicle backend Hexon, ~77 NL dealers). Catalog = Livewire grid on a ONE-segment route whose slug VARIES per dealer (occasions|aanbod|voorraad; wrong slug 404s hard — garagevantreuren.nl/occasions 404, real capture 2026-06-11). Availability truth: wire:snapshot data.filteredOccasionsCount == visible 'Er zijn <N> voertuigen gevonden'; data.perPage=15. ?page=N is CUMULATIVE server-side load-more: GET <slug>?page=ceil(total/15) returns the WHOLE live set in ONE request (janvandijk p1=15, p2=27/27==count re-verified 2026-06-11; lieutenant: auto-nassau p2=29/29). Cards: div.grid-item.grid-item--link (wire:key=hexon id) > first a[href]=PDP; .grid-item-subtitle=make; .grid-item-title h3=model; .grid-item-detail-price[-primary] h4=price; .grid-item-summary-item icons ti-calendar-event/ti-road = year/km (THEME-DEPENDENT, else None). NO JSON-LD anywhere; PDP fields sit in .details-table-item with NL labels (Bouwjaar/Kilometerstand/Brandstof/Transmissie/Kenteken; VIN absent) — so the generic JSON-LD-first engine cannot extract this family: extraction lives in scrapers/dealer_scraping/family_autosociaal.py (harvest_autosociaal -> cage_inventory listings shape). 0-stock dealers are a VALID result (count=0), not drift. sitemap.xml is a flat urlset == live listing and serves as slug hint; the catalog_path_tokens + detail_url_re below keep the generic availability-first listing walk as a degraded fallback (pointers without card fields).
